Available July 2023 · Student House · £125.00 pppw · Great Location

Acorn Properties are pleased to offer this five-bedroom two-bathroom house in a good location in Jesmond. Student property for £125.00pppw. The property is a short walk from Osborne Road bars and around the corner from Francesca's restaurant, as well as a deli, take away and convenience shop. Good size property, impressively presented with private rear yard. To arrange your viewing contact Acorn Properties today and speak to the lettings team.
